Class FireStaff

Attack, BuildModifier
public final class FireStaff extends Staff
The fire staff: a Mage's staff that casts a Fireball from the centre of its owner (GDD 1.3.1). The fireball burns the first character it hurts with the burn of the staff's entry in data/items.json (Q93).
